name: Inngest landing page — 'Unbreakable Agents, Invisible Infra' by inngest.com
description: A near-black developer landing page that leads with typography: an enormous uppercase grotesque headline whose second line drops to outline-only stroke, while floating mono code-callout chips (step.run(), step.waitForEvent()) drift through a particle field. Below the hero the page alternates airy statement sections with dense utilitarian grids — three feature cards with one coral-gradient active tab, a 3×2 durability-primitive grid, a 2×3 use-case grid — all separated by hairline borders on barely-raised panels, with a single coral accent doing all the colour work. The rhythm then shifts through proof (grayscale logo strip, portrait testimonial carousel), explanation (before/after architecture diagram, numbered SDK-step carousel), and trust (throughput line chart, CISO compliance grid), closing with three template quickstart cards and a multi-column footer.
